en: Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not of the fine-material sphere, a neutral state of the fine-material sphere arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not of the fine-material sphere, a neutral state that is not of the fine-material sphere arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Five under root, five under predominance; ... pe ... three under mutuality; ... pe ...
In the case of resultant [condition], there are three …pe… in the case of non-disappearance, five.
